# Video Platform Context

- This product is a web app for live ONVIF and RTSP camera feeds.
- Primary flows include camera setup, live viewing, multi-feed layouts, recording, and playback.
- Prefer designs that separate camera integration, stream handling, recording logic, and operator-facing layout concerns.
- Optimize for reliability, clarity, and maintainable screen structure over flashy frontend tooling.
